authority: Rhode Island Department of Environmental Management and Rhode Island Department of State

review.reviewMethod: Exact catalog-binomial review of the narrow direct-restriction boundary in sections 3.7(D) through 3.7(G), 3.17(A)(1)(c), and 3.17(A)(2)(b).

contradictions.subject: canonical-status-versus-version-detail
contradictions.priorState: The version-detail crawl labels the July 28 amendment inactive and the prior technical revision active.
contradictions.currentEvidence: The canonical current rule page labels the amendment active and effective July 28, 2026.
contradictions.resolution: The canonical current page controls current status for this review; the version-detail discrepancy remains recorded.

contradictions.subject: rule-scope-versus-invasive-applicability
contradictions.priorState: The rule contains broad native-animal and exotic-animal possession provisions beyond invasive and nuisance restrictions.
contradictions.currentEvidence: Only the direct restrictions in the declared nineteen-row boundary have sufficiently narrow invasive or nuisance semantics for this acquisition.
contradictions.resolution: Native-animal lists and broader permit-only exceptions are excluded. Three exact restricted taxa are accepted and sixteen rows remain blocked.

contradictions.subject: source-taxonomy-versus-catalog-taxonomy
contradictions.priorState: Several rows use abbreviations, spellings, genus, family, or category scope that resemble catalog taxa.
contradictions.currentEvidence: Only three rows match current catalog binomials exactly.
contradictions.resolution: No abbreviation, spelling correction, synonym, genus, family, category, or common-name expansion is inferred.

contradictions.subject: rule-membership-versus-occurrence
contradictions.priorState: Rhode Island restricts possession or importation for the reviewed rows.
contradictions.currentEvidence: The rule contains no complete county occurrence survey or explicit negative evidence.
contradictions.resolution: Only state regulatory applicability is recorded. No county presence, absence, not-detected, or not-applicable claim is created.
